slides.headline: OFFICIAL API = [SAFE]
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: Safe hai jab tool **Meta ka official API** use kare aur **password** na maange.

slides.headline: YE TOOLS [AVOID] KARO
slides.label: UNSAFE
lines: **Password** maangne wale bots, strangers ko **mass-DM**, followers **scrape** karna.

slides.headline: [7 DIN] KA RULE
slides.label: INSTAGRAM LIMITS
lines: Har comment pe **ek private reply**, comment ke **7 din** ke andar.

slides.headline: [24 GHANTE] KA WINDOW
slides.label: LIMIT 2
lines: Baaki DMs person ke **last message** ke **24 ghante** ke andar.

slides.headline: BAN KISKO [HOTA] HAI?
slides.label: FAQ
lines: **Spammy content** ya **password bots** se accounts restrict hote hain.
